name: cfform
description:
Builds a form with CFML custom control tags that provide more functionality than standard
HTML form input elements (XML and Flash type not supported).

params.name: name
params.description: A name for the form you are creating.

params.name: action
params.description: The name of the page that executed when the form is submitted for processing.

params.name: preserveData
params.description:
Optional. "Yes" or "No."

Specifies whether to display the data that was entered into cfform controls in the action page.

"Yes" resets the value of the control to the value submitted when the form is submitted to itself. This works as expected for the cftextinput and cfslider controls.

This attribute can be used only if the form and action are on a single page, or if the action page has a form that contains controls with the same names as the corresponding controls on the form page.

**This has not yet been implemented** <https://luceeserver.atlassian.net/browse/LDEV-1171>

params.name: enableCAB
params.description: This attribute has been deprecated and is non-functional.

params.name: target
params.description: The name of the window or window frame to which the form output is sent.

params.name: method
params.description: other than post will ignored

params.name: encType
params.description:
The MIME type used to encode data sent by the POST method.

The default value is application/x-www-form-urlencoded.
It is recommended that you accept the default value. This attribute is included for compatibility with
the HTML form tag.

params.name: passThrough
params.description:
Used for HTML attributes that are not explicitly supported by cfform. If you specify an
attribute and value, they are passed to the HTML code that is generated for the cfinput tag.

params.name: codeBase
params.description:
URL for a downloadable JRE plugin (for Internet explorer only). Default is
/CFIDE/classes/cf-j2re-win.cab.

params.name: archive
params.description: URL for a downloadable Java classes for controls.

params.name: scriptSrc
params.description:
Specifies the URL, relative to the web root, of the
directory that contains the cfform.js file with the
client-side JavaScript used by this tag and its child
tags.

For XML format forms, this directory is also the default directory for XSLT skins.

params.name: id
params.description: HTML id passed through to form tag created, only used for type html.

params.name: onError
params.description: The name of a JavaScript function that runs if a form submission fails.

params.name: onReset
params.description: JavaScript to execute when the user clicks a reset button.

params.name: onLoad
params.description: JavaScript to execute when the form loads.

params.name: onSubmit
params.description:
JavaScript function to execute after other input validation returns. Use this attribute to
execute JavaScript for preprocessing data before the form is submitted

params.name: style
params.description:
Styles to apply to the form. In HTML or XML format,
Lucee passes the style attribute to the browser
or XML. In Flash format, must be a style specification
in CSS format (XML and Flash type not supported).

params.name: class
params.description: passed through to form tag created, only used for type html.

params.name: format
params.description: passed through to form tag created, only used for type html.

params.name: width
params.description:
The width of the form. Use a number to specify
pixels, In Flash, you can use a percentage value to
specify a percentage of the available width.

params.name: height
params.description:
The height of the form. Use a number to specify
pixels. In Flash, you can use a percentage value to
specify a percentage of the available width. The
displayed height might be less than the specified size.

params.name: preloader
params.description:
Specifies whether to display a progress bar when
loading the Flash form. Default is: true.

params.name: timeout
params.description:
Integer number of seconds for which to keep the
form data in the Flash cache on the server. A value of
0 prevents the data from being cached.

params.name: wMode
params.description:
Specifies how the Flash form appears relative to
other displayable content that occupies the same space on an HTML page.

- window: The Flash form is the topmost layer on the page and obscures anything that would share the
space, such as drop-down dynamic HTML lists.
- transparent: The Flash form honors the z-index of DHTML so you can float items above it. If the Flash
form is above any item, transparent regions in the form show the content that is below it.
- opaque: The Flash form honors the z-index of DHTML so you can float items above it. If the Flash form
is above any item, it blocks any content that is below it.

Default is: window.

params.name: accessible
params.description:
Specifies whether to include support screen readers
in the Flash form. Screen reader support adds
approximately 80KB to the SWF file sent to the
client. Default is: false.
